sources.title: Mihai Manea, Non-Cooperative Games
sources.version: January 19, 2017, as actual cover; MIT Spring 2016 course hosting is distinct.
sources.actual_scope: Fresh complete text reading of physical/printed 54–61. Formal equilibrium-dominance and forced-deviation test at 54–55; posterior pricing, single crossing, separation, pooling and refinement at 56–61. Hybrid material read only to delimit our pure scope. Earlier C06 inspection of other pages is not counted as C08 body reading.
sources.supported: Strict equilibrium-dominance comparisons over rational response sets; all-dominated exception; two-type signaling refinement architecture.
sources.excluded: No generic nonlinear-cost extension, mixed/hybrid uniqueness, iterated criterion, D1/D2 or finite sequential-existence theorem is imported. The source calls its continuous model sequential; our maintained posterior-pricing pure PBE is explicitly defined and proved.
sources.proof_choices: At a fixed signal the maintained admissible wage interval is [2+κs,5+κs]. Define D using strict comparison to its maximum; require posterior support outside D only when D is nonempty and proper. Establish profitable forced H deviations and construct all surviving off-path beliefs. At κ=1/3 high equality is not dominance.

sources.title: Bengt Holmström, Lecture Slides – Part 3
sources.version: Cover February 2, 2016; MIT Spring 2017 hosting. Physical pages 1–35 equal slide labels; physical 36 is OCW notice.
sources.actual_scope: Official web body through early finite-type material, followed by complete local text reading physical 18–36, including finite menu/IC recursion 19–23, continuum envelope caveat 24–31 and virtual-cost transformation 32–35. Cover/date read locally.
sources.supported: Committed menu reduction and IC/IR architecture; envelope/rent integration and virtual-surplus logic, after translating procurement cost types into buyer value types.
sources.excluded: No general ironing algorithm, strict-positive-rent assertion under exclusion, or global optimality from first-order conditions alone. Slide 28 expressly assumes differentiability; our bounded monotone Riemann-sum envelope proof does not rely on that assumption.
sources.proof_choices: Payments here flow buyer→seller and utility is θq−t; source procurement transfers flow the other way. Independently derive all signs. Replace slide 21 informal only-binding and strictly positive language with weak IC/minimal rents, allowing exclusion and identical bunching contracts. Supply finite tangent certificates and a feasible pointwise continuum optimum.

retrieval: Holmström retrieved from the official URL by author; Manea PDF/text reused unchanged from C06 evidence. Six new PNGs rendered by pdftoppm and actually inspected using view_image. No source pages embedded in reader HTML.

original_proof_routes.finite: Pairwise IC implies monotonicity and adjacent utility bounds; telescope for sufficiency. Minimal rents and finite sum interchange give exact objective; strict concavity plus tangent certificates prove global optima.
original_proof_routes.continuum: Pairwise bounds sandwich utility increments between every lower/upper monotone Riemann sum. Sufficiency by integral bounds handles jumps. Bounded allocation and continuous positive density justify rent integration.
original_proof_routes.lotteries: Interim report utilities linear in quality/payment; finite-support Jensen proved and general bounded-quality Jensen stated with supporting-line justification; counterexample only compares fixed contracts.
original_proof_routes.signaling: Complete two-action-type pure classification, global off-path best responses, strict dominated-type tests, then positive/zero/negative high net-cost regimes.

limits: Only the two stated primary bodies and scoped equations were inspected. Numerical examples are synthetic, and model equilibrium/refinement is not behavioral or causal evidence. C08 has no claim about all mixed signaling outcomes.
